source_closure.build_only_overlay_changes: Trace v2 pause/resume preservation, truthful per-record capture-body-cycle label, runtime CPU MHz fail-closed start/resume check, and unique diagnostic release identity. No rendering/Vibe/audio/Text behavior changes.

cpu_frequency.power_management: Selected ESP32 sdkconfig has CONFIG_PM_ENABLE unset; source closure contains no later setCpuFrequencyMhz or esp_pm_configure call.
cpu_frequency.runtime_guard: Trace start requires ESP.getCpuFreqMHz()==F_CPU/1000000; resume requires current MHz==captured MHz; readback exposes compile, start, and readback MHz. A mismatch invalidates the window.

target_timing_provenance.task_core: Pinned Arduino main.cpp creates loopTask on CONFIG_ARDUINO_RUNNING_CORE=1. WLED loop executes strip.service; WLED output calls BusManager::show; the HBNF measurement object is initialized by the matrix effect and finalized from BusManager::show. ESP.getCycleCount is per-core and all captured values therefore originate on the same pinned renderer task/core.
target_timing_provenance.frame_correlation: Trace-relative frameSequence increments once at frame end while armed. Frame start/end/whole, kernel/audio/color/scheduler/overlay/companion/DDP/unaccounted totals, kernel id, and variant signature are copied from the same HbnfPerfWorking object. It is not represented as a native WLED frame number.
expert_basis: Espressif ESP-IDF v5.2.4 performance guidance: cycle counts are per-core; use only from a pinned task/ISR; esp_timer has moderate overhead and is suitable only for the rare outlier correlation timestamp; short microbenchmarks vary with cache state. https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/v5.2.4/esp32/api-guides/performance/speed.html
Exact pinned framework source and sdkconfig were checked locally; the online ESP-IDF v5.2.5 S3 Kconfig page is not treated as evidence for this ESP32 target.

trace_contract.threshold_role: Capture/diagnostic threshold only; its production p99 exceedance is not an early-stop condition.

storage.overwrite_counter: Saturating counter increments on each outlier write after the recent ring is full.
storage.pause_resume: stop pauses; resume preserves frame sequence, ring, counts and worst record; initial start is one-shot per boot and clears state.
storage.readback: Serialize only after stop; fixed decimal CSV strings preserve 64-bit timestamp under pinned ArduinoJson configuration.

hot_path.record_cost_field: traceCaptureBodyCycles; includes outlier timestamp acquisition and record construction/append. It excludes the final self-accounting field write and the enclosing critical-section exit; it is not total observer overhead.
hot_path.observer_effect_measurement: Matched trace-disarmed/trace-armed full windows compare p99, max, FPS and sample count; no acceptance limit is invented.

build.offline_proof_limit: Code generation, static storage, and partitions are measured; actual ESP32 runtime observer effect has not been measured.

rollback.availability: Exact local SHA reverified; prior Drive preservation receipt identifies exact same SHA. Reverify before any future live transaction.

offline_tests.result: ALL PASS; control model valid and live mutation authority false.

live_readiness.reason: Quiet windows prohibit polling, but the frozen catastrophic abort needs 8-second samples and aborts after three consecutive bad samples. Neither requirement is weakened. Exact protocol presents the conflict; no live operation is authorized here.
